about: The evaluation endpoints Carbon publishes (LP-PROD-E): for a network, subnet, Challenge and Challenge version, the validator intake a frozen candidate is submitted to and the hotkey published as its receiver. A receiver serves exactly one Challenge version, so each entry names its version (v2, Validator ruling 2026-10-21). Setup's Review writes each entry into the miner's runner profile for exactly that version, with its receiver_hotkey pinned beside it; with no entry for a version, setup and the prelaunch review say the profile cannot submit to it yet. An operator adds the live entry by pull request (docs/development/BATTERY_VALIDATOR_SERVICE_RUNBOOK.md). Entries for another network or subnet are skipped. A list that breaks the schema, or names a version that is not a registered intake version of its Challenge, publishes nothing. A v1 list (entries without version) is still read: an entry applies to its Challenge only where the Challenge has exactly one intake version, and to none where it has several.

entry_fields.network: the chain network, as carbon.chain.models.CARBON_NETWORK names it, for example testnet
entry_fields.netuid: the subnet, an integer, for example 567
entry_fields.challenge: the Challenge id, as the Challenge registry names it
entry_fields.version: the Challenge version the intake serves, exactly as the Challenge registry names it, for example 1.2
entry_fields.receiver_hotkey: the ss58 hotkey of the validator published as the receiver; the profile pins it, and the intake must report it before anything is signed for it
